product.title: HTML to Markdown and Clean Text API
product.short_description: Convert submitted HTML into readable Markdown or clean text with predictable JSON responses.
product.long_description: Send UTF-8 HTML in a small JSON request and receive Markdown or clean text plus input-byte and output-character statistics. Includes bounded input/output, fixed error codes, and runnable curl, JavaScript and Python examples. This service converts supplied HTML only. It does not fetch URLs, execute scripts, render a browser page, provide AI summaries or guarantee pixel-perfect fidelity.

category.instruction: Select exactly one category from the current RapidAPI Studio dropdown; record the exact supported name before approval.

support.instruction: Provide a monitored public support email or approved issue tracker before approval; do not publish a placeholder.

product.privacy_notice: The application does not intentionally persist submitted HTML or conversion output, and Worker response headers use no-store. Marketplace, network, and cloud providers may retain operational metadata under their own policies.
limitations: Submitted HTML only; no remote URL retrieval.
Unsupported structures may use readable text fallback.
Strict byte, complexity, and output limits.
Relative links may remain relative; unsafe URLs are restricted.
No production availability, CPU, SLA or earnings guarantees.
product.auth: RapidAPI subscribers use marketplace-provided X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host; the gateway-to-origin secret is never customer-facing.

verified_claims.claim: Both conversion endpoints and liveness path
Exact example responses and error behavior
No application logging and production Workers Logs disabled
Free-tier capacity remains unconfirmed pending other Worker traffic

rate_limits.rule: A monthly hard quota alone cannot prevent a one-day burst. Configure account-safe per-plan second/minute/hour controls only after confirming aggregate capacity.
